purpose: Persistent HF Storage Bucket contract for the visual lab: models, generated-asset cache, benchmark fixtures and records, render artifacts. Keeps Space git clean (Spaces have ephemeral disk).

/models/.rule: model weights cached per vendor family; each dir carries a MANIFEST.json with model_id, hf_sha, download timestamp

/visual-cache/generated-assets/.rule: every generated asset stored with a sidecar <asset>.epistemic.json carrying: epistemic_class (COMPUTATIONAL_RENDER at most), generator (hf:<model-id>@<sha>), lineage root (canonical GLB sha256), case id

/benchmarks/.rule: canonical fixture GLBs (sha256-verified against protocol.json anchors) + typed VISUAL_BENCHMARK_RECORD outputs; append-only, never overwritten

/renders/.rule: canonical renderer outputs referenced by lineage; lab variants live under /visual-cache, never here unless they passed the fidelity gate and are labeled presentation_enhanced

rules: no buyer-surface asset is ever published from the bucket directly; the visual compiler remains the only publisher
records are append-only; corrections are new records referencing the old record id
retention: benchmark records and fixtures are kept indefinitely (evidence); generated-asset cache may be pruned after registry entry point to the archived record
